title: Astronomers witness supermassive black hole gorge on a cosmic meal before 'burping' radio jets 300 days later
caption:
Astronomers have spotted a supermassive black hole in the Perseus Cluster acting like a glutton. After a massive X-ray flare signaling a cosmic meal, it waited nearly a year to launch a radio jet. This observation helps us understand the messy relationship between black holes and the galaxies they live in.

Source: Space - Astronomers witness supermassive black hole gorge on a cosmic meal before 'burping' radio jets 300 days later
